message:
Partial refunds now come out at the right amount, and `npm test` passes (20 of 20).

The bug was in `src/payments/partial-refund.js`. The code multiplied the amount by `percent`, but `percent` is a 0–100 value, so a 50% refund came out 50 times too large. It now divides by 100 before rounding. A 50% refund of 1250 GBP is now 625, and a 100% refund returns the full 1250.
